column1: The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
IT is hereby declared that the names of the members elected for each ward of the Local Authority indicated in Column II
of the Schedule below of the Local Authority Specified in Column II situated in the administrative district specified in
Column I and the names of members returned for the Local Authority shall be specified below. This is an addition to the
names  published  in  the  Gazette  Extraordinary  No.  2147/48  dated  09th  October  2019.
